title: nepeta hederacea
intro: Nepeta hederacea, commonly known as wood betony, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of wood betony include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which contribute to its calming and soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
